code:
use default
use IO.Std.read_line
use System.Random

let jumps = MAP[int, int]()

for (from, to) in [
    (4, 14), (9, 31), (17, 7), (20, 38), (28, 84), (40, 59),
    (51, 67), (54, 34), (62, 19), (63, 81), (64, 60), (71, 91),
    (87, 24), (93, 73), (95, 75), (99, 78)
] do
    jumps[from] = to
od

let random = Random(3)

move(who: string, rolls: string, square: int) -> int is
    let roll = random.next(1, 7)

    if square + roll > 100 then
        write_line("{who} {rolls} {roll} and cannot move from {square}")
        return square
    fi

    let landed = square + roll
    write_line("{who} {rolls} {roll}, moving to {landed}")

    if !jumps.contains_key(landed) then
        return landed
    fi

    let next = jumps[landed]
    write_line(
        if next > landed then "  a ladder up to {next}"
        else "  a snake down to {next}"
        fi)

    next
si

let you mut = 1
let computer mut = 1

while you < 100 /\ computer < 100 do
    write_line("press enter to roll")

    if !read_line()? then
        write_line("game abandoned")
        break
    fi

    you = move("you", "roll", you)

    if you < 100 then
        computer = move("the computer", "rolls", computer)
    fi
od

if you == 100 then
    write_line("you win")
elif computer == 100 then
    write_line("the computer wins")
fi
